fields.v: No (0): authors from The Memory Company, which builds Spark (vendor of the approach); Spark is the only approach evaluated, and the NO-SPARK conditions are the same external models run without any approach, not alternative approaches by other vendors
fields.quote: • NO-SPARK: [baseline] A codegen model generates code without any Spark recommendations, representing raw codegen model use.
fields.why: The only approach evaluated is the authors' own Spark; the NO-SPARK baselines are bare models rather than external approaches, so Partly (authors' approach compared with external ones) may not apply.
fields.doubt: O Spark é dos autores (The Memory Company). O NO-SPARK é o mesmo modelo sem nenhuma abordagem, não uma abordagem externa. Vê a pág. 7 e decide: Parcial (os modelos externos contam como ferramentas avaliadas) ou Não (só o Spark é avaliado como abordagem).
